title: Booking (enriched) v1
description: The payload published on the booking.enriched topic and consumed by TMS: all raw fields unchanged except origin/destination (which carry the matched canonical city name), plus a nested enrichment audit block. Derived verbatim from SPEC.md section 4 ("Enriched booking (booking.enriched)").
$comment: B-10 fixture: a predecessor whose confidence scores were integers. The current schema widens them to number, so every payload that validated against this version still validates against the current one - the definition of a backward compatible change, and the half of the pair that proves the checker does not simply reject every difference.

bookingId.description: Unchanged from booking.raw. Also the Kafka message key (SPEC section 3).

origin.description: Canonical origin city name as matched by CityMatcher (SPEC section 5), e.g. "Mumbai". Casing matches src/main/resources/cities.json exactly (SPEC section 4).

destination.description: Canonical destination city name as matched by CityMatcher (SPEC section 5), e.g. "New Delhi".

enrichment.description: Audit block recording what was originally supplied and how confident the match was (SPEC section 4). Confidence values are illustrative of the SPEC section 5 algorithm, not a fixed contract value.

originalOrigin.description: The raw, uncorrected origin exactly as it arrived on booking.raw.

originalDestination.description: The raw, uncorrected destination exactly as it arrived on booking.raw.

originConfidence.description: Jaro-Winkler similarity backing the origin match (SPEC section 5), in the closed interval [0, 1].

destinationConfidence.description: Jaro-Winkler similarity backing the destination match (SPEC section 5), in the closed interval [0, 1].
